SEN.note: Says only that Starlink must comply with national data protection provisions; names no law, authority, regulation or decision.

facts.fact: FDSUT chair Lamine Sène says the state negotiated a programme to acquire 5,000 Starlink kits, 1,000 of them free, to give 1 million people free internet access including remote areas, with no count of sites connected.

SEN.note: Mentions sovereignty and data localisation only in general terms for Starlink; no rule or goal on state data.
No budget amount, fund account or statement on domestic financing; FDSUT programme has no stated amount.

systems.system: ARTP national internet observatory fixed-internet penetration

SEN.note: Only a fixed-internet penetration rate, a subscription measure, not a share of people using the internet.

facts.fact: FDSUT chair Lamine Sène says Starlink operates under an internet service provider authorisation delivered by the authorities and is now available in Senegal.
